messages.content: The return has been changed to Friday morning, so I need Thursday night added. Compare staying at the Delta all four nights, moving to an airport hotel after Thursday's closing meeting, and switching the whole stay to the other hotel near the site. Include tax and parking.

For June 16-20, the Delta would total $793: $733 for the room and tax plus $60 for four nights of parking. The airport split would total $722: $528 for the first three nights at the Delta, $45 parking there, then $139 including tax at the airport hotel and $10 parking. The other site-area hotel is $676 including tax for all four nights, with complimentary parking.
How much convenience do I actually gain by moving Thursday night? The Friday flight is at 9:10 a.m.

The airport hotel is about five minutes from the terminal and offers a shuttle beginning at 4:30 a.m. From the two site-area hotels, the normal early-morning drive is about 12 to 18 minutes. For a 9:10 departure, leaving either site-area property around 6:40 should still allow two hours at RDU. Moving after the meeting saves roughly 15 minutes Friday morning but requires checking out, transporting luggage, and checking in Thursday evening.
Check the cancellation deadlines on all three arrangements. Also confirm the consistent-rate hotel does not add a destination or facilities fee.

The Delta extension is cancellable without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on June 15. The split keeps that same deadline for the Delta portion; the airport hotel's Thursday night can be cancelled until 6:00 p.m. on June 18. The consistent-rate hotel allows cancellation until 11:59 p.m. on June 15. Its $676 total includes room tax and mandatory charges, and the property confirms there is no destination, resort, or facilities fee.
Reserve the consistent-rate hotel for all four nights. Cancel the existing Delta reservation once the replacement is confirmed, and keep the trip within the approved $1,466.

The consistent-rate site-area hotel is confirmed for June 16-20 at $676 including tax and complimentary parking, cancellable until 11:59 p.m. local time June 15. The prior Delta Hotels reservation for June 16-19 has been cancelled without penalty. With the reissued airfare at $514 and the existing $214 ground-transportation allowance, the trip total is $1,404, which is $62 below the approved $1,466.
